name: @agent-org/plugin-telegram
description: Telegram as the messaging provider: asks and announcements for the chairman, sent through a bot whose token is read by reference from a file.

agentOrg.description: Telegram: asks and announcements for the chairman. Configured in project.json's messaging key.

tokenFile.explanation: The file holding the bot's token, read by reference and never shown. It must be a regular file of mode 0600 owned by the running user.
tokenFile.breaks: A path outside ~/.config/agent-org/, or a file others can read, is refused by name, and nothing is sent.

edit.why: a secret's file: change it with `agent-org plugin config telegram`

chairmanFile.explanation: The file `messaging:pair` writes with the chairman's Telegram ids. Nobody types the ids anywhere.
chairmanFile.breaks: A path outside ~/.config/agent-org/ is refused by name. Until the chairman has paired, the file is absent and nothing can be sent.

edit.why: a secret's file: change it with `agent-org plugin config telegram`

announcementsFile.default: announcements go to the chairman's chat
announcementsFile.setCommand: ( umask 077; read -r -p "announcements chat id: " C; printf '%s' "$C" > {value|~/.config/agent-org/telegram-announcements} )
announcementsFile.explanation: The file holding the chat id of a one-way announcements channel. Absent, announcements go to the chairman's chat.
announcementsFile.breaks: A path outside ~/.config/agent-org/ is refused by name; a file holding anything but one chat id is refused when the provider is built.

edit.why: a secret's file: change it with `agent-org plugin config telegram`
